items.title: Applied Materials (AMAT) Stock Looks Above Fair Value After Its 127% Run
items.summary: Applied Materials has ridden the AI chip equipment wave to strong longer term gains, yet the recent pullback now puts a sharper spotlight on whether the current price still lines up with the cash the business can generate over time. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 127.5%, which puts a lot of past optimism into the valuation question around its future cash flows.
